name: use-messaging
title: useMessages, useConversations
description: useMessages and useConversations: the messaging block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the messaging block (`npx better-supabase add messaging`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/messaging.
